flashChat.unreachableTitle: Members on other networks may not be able to join
flashChat.unreachableHint: This computer got no address that other networks can reach, usually because a proxy's TUN or virtual adapter takes UDP traffic. Members on the same local network can still join. To let others join, let WinOne or UDP bypass the proxy, or add a TURN server to the WebRTC configuration in Network settings.
